title: INTEGRATED MARKETING COMMUNICATIONS
description: Analysis of the influence of marketing communications on the attitudes and behaviors of consumer and industrial buyers. Identification and examination of the major decisions made by marketing/advertising managers in implementing the promotional mix.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 223, 223H, 390 or 390H.
A minimum grade of C is required in BA 223, BA 223H, BA 390 and BA 390H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman, Sophomore or Junior may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Sports Business (020)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Marketing (814)
  • Professional Sales (817)
  • Digital Marketing Analytics (903)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Sports Business (A050)
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
